people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Jeroboam
people.line: First king of the northern kingdom of Israel.

translations.web: The children of Israel walked in all the sins of Jeroboam which he did; they didn’t depart from them
translations.bsb: The Israelites persisted in all the sins that Jeroboam had committed and did not turn away from them.
translations.kjv: For the children of Israel walked in all the sins of Jeroboam which he did; they departed not from them;
translations.asv: And the children of Israel walked in all the sins of Jeroboam which he did; they departed not from them;
